summary: Page 9, 'Lodge and Club News' section. Target item 'Paterson College President Cited as a Foe of Prejudice' reports that Dr. Herbert Spencer Robinson, president of the College of Paterson, was praised as a champion of the Negro race and opponent of discrimination in an article published in The Jersey Guardian, a statewide newspaper for Black readers; Robinson was quoted favoring boycotts to fight racial segregation. Elsewhere on the same page, a National Association for the Advancement of Colored People item covers the Paterson Branch's meeting featuring NAACP field secretary Dean William Pickens, introduced by Robinson.

people.name: Dr. Herbert Spencer Robinson
people.role: President, College of Paterson; scholar of English literature; praised by The Jersey Guardian as a foe of prejudice; introduced Dean William Pickens at an NAACP Paterson Branch meeting

people.name: Dean William Pickens
people.role: Field secretary of the NAACP; celebrated Negro leader; guest speaker at Paterson Branch NAACP meeting

people.name: Rev. Herbert C. Cole
people.role: President, New Jersey State Federation of Teachers; separately reported (same page) as dismissed as a Trenton teacher for striking a student — not part of the Guardian item

incidents.what: The Jersey Guardian publishes article praising Dr. Herbert Spencer Robinson as a champion of the Negro race and foe of prejudice
NAACP Paterson Branch meeting at which Dr. Robinson introduced NAACP field secretary Dean William Pickens, who reviewed progress of Black Americans since the Civil War

NAACP Paterson Branch activity tied to Robinson on the same page
